problem_type: Partial nightly evidence mistaken for recovery; first failure state overwritten
symptom: 11-04 four failed installation batches plus one exit0 produced a recovery comment; 11-08 only 190 of 380 results appeared.
direct_cause: Report consumed TSV only, inferred passes by subtraction, and overwrote the issue without reading prior state.
class_root: The report boundary has no explicit expected population, batch provenance or persisted per-walk transition invariant.
affected_population: Every nightly matrix batch, packaged smoke and subsequent issue update
entry_points: issue body from the previous report

external_sources.purpose: needs job result is aggregated, not per-matrix evidence
always runs the report after failed dependencies
toJSON transports needs without shell interpolation

invariants: Only explicit exit0 is green; exit125 and absent/invalid/duplicate results cannot erase a known red.
Recovery requires all expected current-SHA batch evidence, successful needs, no missing, skipped, failed or unknown state.
Only new observed red transitions yield one consolidated comment; first activation records stock without inventing first-red history.

door_reduction.why_not: The summary CLI owns ingestion and issue persistence; its node tests independently exercise both exports. They share one implementation and must remain separate callers.

generality_proof: One summary boundary validates expected inventory and provenance for Linux and packaged smoke, then merges only explicit observed green/red into the same persisted ledger.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate complete expected evidence and separate green, skipped, missing and failed.
Read and validate the previous ledger before merging observed per-walk transitions.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Each matrix batch records a manifest before dependency installation and final sentinel even after failure.
Packaged smoke records the same manifest/sentinel protocol and remains independently counted.

recurrence.reason: The same subtraction and empty-failure recovery path executes on every incomplete nightly run.
same_class_scan: rg nightly-walk-summary summarizeRows classifyRow readRows updateIssue scripts tests .github docs/fixes
Checked prior 7add33774 direction check and current workflow report, Linux matrix and packaged smoke producers.

prevention.invariant: No recovery or green status can be inferred from missing, skipped, malformed or untrusted evidence.
prevention.failure_mode: Render infrastructure failure/unknown and retain previously known red; invalid persisted state never implies recovery.
prevention.strategy: Replace subtraction/default-product/overwrite with explicit completeness validation and persisted observed-state transitions.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove implicit-product classification, subtraction-based pass count, unconditional empty-failure recovery and daily overwrite without merging.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse existing Node APIs, gh wrappers and Actions; no dependency change controls the invariant.

migration: Missing legacy state initializes observed reds as stock with unknown first-red provenance. Malformed state is visibly unknown; never reconstruct invented history.
residual_risks: No live issue writes or workflow dispatch permitted; actual GitHub roundtrip remains unverified.
